audit.integrityScope: All original scene attribute references/bytes, every material binding/physical scalar, every procedural image byte/source/version and all object transforms. Only target geometry references are replaced; their fully private protected attributes/index must retain exact values.

authoredShadingNormalTransport.comparison: Stored shading normals vs independent cofactor inverse-transpose of those same authored normals. This does not assert agreement with flat geometric normals.

geometricFiniteDifference.comparison: Central differences of the continuous displaced position on each actual source triangle, parameterized by its actual barycentric position and UV interpolation, vs transported original flat triangle normal. Float32 UV-position residuals are reported separately.

updatedTriangleOrientation.comparison: Actual deformed endpoint triangle cross product vs transported original flat triangle normal at its centroid. This checks endpoint mesh orientation separately from the continuous-field finite difference.

narisAttachment.scope: Same-UV head-Z overlay separation against actual original/deformed continuous-face triangles. The finite nonzero gap change is endpoint resampling, not a change of UV registration.
